caption:
वादा किया तो निभाना पड़ेगा! Sanam Teri Kasam के प्रोड्यूसर दीपक मुकुट ने अपना वादा पूरा करते हुए एक्टर हर्षवर्धन राणे को 3.5 करोड़ रुपये से ज्यादा की ब्रांड न्यू Land Rover Defender Octa कार गिफ्ट की है। 🚗

दरअसल, पिछले साल हर्षवर्धन राणे ने इस फिल्म की री-रिलीज़ का पूरा सपोर्ट किया था। दीपक मुकुट ने Instagram पर फोटो शेयर कर लिखा कि जैसे आपने फिल्म का साथ दिया, वैसे ही आज मैं अपना वादा निभा रहा हूं।

इसके जवाब में हर्षवर्धन राणे ने पोस्ट शेयर करके प्रोड्यूसर से खास मांग रख दी। एक्टर ने कहा कि अगले महीने उनके बर्थडे पर वह फैंस के साथ फिर ऑफिस के बाहर आएंगे और उनकी एक ही रिक्वेस्ट होगी- Sanam Teri Kasam 2 के लिए अप्रूवल! 🎬

बता दें कि राधिका राव और विनय सप्रू के डायरेक्शन में बनी Sanam Teri Kasam पहली बार 5 फरवरी 2016 को रिलीज़ हुई थी और करीब 8 करोड़ कमाकर फ्लॉप रही थी।

लेकिन 7 फरवरी 2025 को जब यह फिर री-रिलीज़ हुई, तो इसने ओपनिंग डे पर 4.25 करोड़ और इंडिया नेट कलेक्शन में 42 करोड़ रुपये कमाए, जबकि वर्ल्डवाइड ग्रॉस 54 करोड़ रुपये रहा। 🔥

क्या आपको लगता है कि प्रोड्यूसर को Sanam Teri Kasam 2 की मंजूरी दे देनी चाहिए? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Harshvardhan Rane gets  ₹3.5 crore luxury car from Sanam Teri Kasam producer, asks him to approve film's sequel
ctx.summary: Producer Deepak Mukut gifted Harshvardhan Rane a Land Rover Defender Octa, reportedly worth over  ₹3.5 crore, after the film’s successful 2025 re-release.
ctx.text:
Actor Harshvardhan Rane recently took to Instagram to share that Sanam Teri Kasam producer Deepak Mukut had kept his promise and gifted him a luxury car worth over ₹ 3.5 crore. The actor shared a picture of Mukut handing him the keys to a new Land Rover Defender Octa, which is reportedly priced at over ₹ 3.5 crore in India.
Deepak Mukut shared a picture of himself gifting Harshvardhan the new vehicle and wrote, “Harsh, thank you for standing by our film last year with the re-release of #sanamterikasam. Just as you stood by the film last year, today I stand by my word. A promise is a promise, and this is a small gesture of my appreciation.”
Harshvardhan reshared the post on Instagram and urged the producer to make Sanam Teri Kasam 2. Thanking Mukut for keeping his word, the actor wrote, “Deepak Sir I’ve been part of many promises, but you stand apart. You’re truly a man of your word. Sir, just as I stood outside your office (Soham Rockstar Entertainment) last year, alongside fans requesting the re-release of Sanam Teri Kasam, I’ll be back at your doorstep with them on my birthday next month. This time, with one request: your approval for Sanam Teri Kasam 2. Script and Director of your choice! Will you grant me and the fans this birthday wish, sir? ❤️.”
A post shared by Harshvardhan Rane (@harshvardhanrane)
Sanam Teri Kasam, directed by Radhika Rao and Vinay Sapru, was originally released in theatres on February 5, 2016. The film starred Harshvardhan Rane and Pakistani actor Mawra Hocane in the lead roles, with Harshvardhan playing Inder and Mawra portraying Saru.
The film failed to make an impact at the box office during its original theatrical run, collecting around ₹ 8 crore in India and declared a box office flop. However, it gradually developed a loyal fan after its release on digital platforms.
Nine years after its original release, the film returned to theatres on February 7, 2025. Its re-release received an unexpectedly strong response, with the film collecting around ₹ 4.25 crore on its opening day in India. It went on to earn over ₹ 42 crore in India net collection, while its worldwide gross collection stood at approximately ₹ 54 crore. The film's box-office success made it one of the biggest success stories among Indian film re-releases.
